# Canvas

Header: `winui/ui/panels/Canvas.hpp`. Spec: `winui/ui/panels/Canvas.hpp`.

Children placed at absolute left/top offsets (DIPs) from its top-left corner, drawn in z-index order.

Every child is measured with unbounded room and arranged at its own desired size. The [Canvas](#uicanvas) itself asks for no room at all. It takes the size its width/height or its slot give it. It does not clip, so a child placed past its edge still draws there. Children draw lowest z-index first, ties in the order added, and the topmost child gets the wheel first. The background comes from [Panel::set_background()](panel.md#set_background).

Example: 
```cpp
auto canvas = std::make_unique<ui::CanvasControl>();
canvas->set_width(140.0f);
canvas->set_height(140.0f);
canvas->set_background(ui::Color::from_rgba(128, 128, 128));

auto square = std::make_unique<ui::RectangleControl>();
square->set_width(40.0f);
square->set_height(40.0f);
square->set_fill(ui::Color::from_rgba(255, 0, 0));
ui::RectangleControl* red = canvas->add(std::move(square), 20.0f, 30.0f);
canvas->set_z_index(red, 5); // drawn above every child with a lower z-index
canvas->set_left(red, 60.0f); // moves it and updates the layout
window.set_content(std::move(canvas));

// Declaratively, with bindable placements:
ui::Property<float> left{20.0f};
window.set_content(ui::Canvas{
    .width    = 140.0f,
    .height   = 140.0f,
    .content  = {
        ui::CanvasItem{.left    = left,
         .top     = 30.0f,
         .content = ui::Rectangle{.fill = ui::colors::Black, .width = 40.0f, .height = 40.0f}},
        ui::CanvasItem{.left = 60.0f, .top = 60.0f, .z_index = 1, .content = ui::Text{.text = "On top"}},
    },
});
```

## `ui::Canvas`

Children at absolute offsets. Builds a [ui::CanvasControl](#uicanvascontrol).

A canvas does not size to its children; give it a [`width`](../conventions.md#common-fields-on-every-spec)/[`height`](../conventions.md#common-fields-on-every-spec) (or a stretching slot).

Example: 
```cpp
ui::Property<float> x{0.0f};

window.set_content(ui::VerticalStack{.spacing = 8, .content = {
    ui::Canvas{
        .background = ui::Color::from_rgba(200, 200, 200),
        .width      = 140.0f,
        .height     = 140.0f,
        .content    = {
            ui::CanvasItem{.left = x, .top = 10.0f, .z_index = 2,
             .content = ui::Border{.background = ui::colors::Black, .width = 40.0f, .height = 40.0f}},
            ui::CanvasItem{.left = 20.0f, .top = 20.0f, .z_index = 1,
             .content = ui::Border{.background = ui::colors::White, .width = 40.0f, .height = 40.0f}},
        },
    },
    ui::Button{.text = "Move", .on_click = [&] { x += 10.0f; }},
}});
```

Every field, in the order a designated initializer names them:

```cpp
ui::Canvas{
    .background, .style, .margin, .width, .height, .min_width, .min_height, .max_width,
    .max_height, .horizontal_alignment, .vertical_alignment, .visible, .tool_tip, .enabled,
    .accessibility, .on_pointer_entered, .on_pointer_exited, .on_got_focus, .on_lost_focus,
    .on_key_down, .on_wheel, .control, .content
}
```

Fields, in declaration order (designators must follow it):

| Field | Type | Default | |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| <span id="uicanvas-background"></span>`background` | `ui::Binding<ui::Paint>` |  | Background: a [Color](../core/color.md), or a [ThemeColor](../tree/theme-color.md) read from the theme; empty (the default) draws none. |
| <span id="uicanvas-on_pointer_entered"></span>`on_pointer_entered` | `ui::Action` |  | The pointer moved onto the control. |
| <span id="uicanvas-on_pointer_exited"></span>`on_pointer_exited` | `ui::Action` |  | The pointer left the control. |
| <span id="uicanvas-on_got_focus"></span>`on_got_focus` | `ui::Action` |  | Keyboard focus arrived on the control, or on anything inside it, from outside it. A control with nothing focusable in it never gets focus, and never raises this. |
| <span id="uicanvas-on_lost_focus"></span>`on_lost_focus` | `ui::Action` |  | Keyboard focus left the control and everything inside it. |
| <span id="uicanvas-on_key_down"></span>`on_key_down` | `ui::Callback<ui::Handling(const ui::KeyEvent&)>` |  | A key pressed while focus is on the control or inside it, before the control's own handling; [ui::Handled](../core/namespace-ui.md#handled) stops it there ([Element::on_key_down()](../tree/element.md#on_key_down)). |
| <span id="uicanvas-on_wheel"></span>`on_wheel` | `ui::Callback<ui::Handling(const ui::PointerEvent&)>` |  | A wheel turn over the control, before the control scrolls; [ui::Handled](../core/namespace-ui.md#handled) stops it there ([Element::on_wheel()](../tree/element.md#on_wheel)). |
| <span id="uicanvas-control"></span>`control` | `ui::ControlOut<ui::Canvas>` |  | Out: the handle that receives the built control. |
| <span id="uicanvas-content"></span>`content` | `ui::CanvasItemList` |  | The positioned children; see [ui::CanvasItem](#uicanvasitem). |

Plus the common fields `style`, `margin`, `width`, `height`, `min_width`, `min_height`, `max_width`, `max_height`, `horizontal_alignment`, `vertical_alignment`, `visible`, `tool_tip`, `enabled`, `accessibility` every spec carries ([conventions](../conventions.md#common-fields-on-every-spec)).

### build

```cpp
std::unique_ptr<Element> build()&&
```

Consumes the spec and returns the built [ui::CanvasControl](#uicanvascontrol); the caller owns it.

## `ui::CanvasItem`

One child of a [Canvas](#uicanvas) with its left and top offsets and z-index, each bindable. Written inline in a [ui::Canvas](#uicanvas)'s [`.content`](#uicanvasitem-content); see [ui::Canvas](#uicanvas) for an example.

Every field, in the order a designated initializer names them:

```cpp
ui::CanvasItem{
    .left, .top, .z_index, .content
}
```

Fields, in declaration order (designators must follow it):

| Field | Type | Default | |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| <span id="uicanvasitem-left"></span>`left` | `ui::Binding<float>` | `{0.0f}` | Offset from the canvas's left, DIPs. |
| <span id="uicanvasitem-top"></span>`top` | `ui::Binding<float>` | `{0.0f}` | Offset from the canvas's top, DIPs. |
| <span id="uicanvasitem-z_index"></span>`z_index` | `ui::Binding<int>` | `{0}` | Higher draws on top. |
| <span id="uicanvasitem-content"></span>`content` | `ui::Spec` |  | The placed child. |

## `ui::CanvasControl`

Derives from `ui::Panel`.

Children placed at absolute left/top offsets (DIPs) from its top-left corner, drawn in z-index order.

Every child is measured with unbounded room and arranged at its own desired size. The [Canvas](#uicanvas) itself asks for no room at all. It takes the size its width/height or its slot give it. It does not clip, so a child placed past its edge still draws there. Children draw lowest z-index first, ties in the order added, and the topmost child gets the wheel first. The background comes from [Panel::set_background()](panel.md#set_background).

Example: 
```cpp
auto canvas = std::make_unique<ui::CanvasControl>();
canvas->set_width(140.0f);
canvas->set_height(140.0f);
canvas->set_background(ui::Color::from_rgba(128, 128, 128));

auto square = std::make_unique<ui::RectangleControl>();
square->set_width(40.0f);
square->set_height(40.0f);
square->set_fill(ui::Color::from_rgba(255, 0, 0));
ui::RectangleControl* red = canvas->add(std::move(square), 20.0f, 30.0f);
canvas->set_z_index(red, 5); // drawn above every child with a lower z-index
canvas->set_left(red, 60.0f); // moves it and updates the layout
window.set_content(std::move(canvas));

// Declaratively, with bindable placements:
ui::Property<float> left{20.0f};
window.set_content(ui::Canvas{
    .width    = 140.0f,
    .height   = 140.0f,
    .content  = {
        ui::CanvasItem{.left    = left,
         .top     = 30.0f,
```

### CanvasControl

```cpp
CanvasControl() = default
```

An empty canvas; with no width/height set it takes whatever its slot gives it.

### add

```cpp
template <typename T>
T* add(std::unique_ptr<T> child, float left = 0.0f, float top = 0.0f, int z_index = 0)
```

Takes ownership of a child placed at ([`left`](#left), [`top`](#top)), DIPs from the canvas' top-left, at [`z_index`](#z_index), and returns a non-owning observer, as [StackControl::add()](stack.md#add) does. Updates the layout. A null `child` is ignored and returns nullptr.

### add

```cpp
template <SpecLike S>
Element* add(S&& spec, float left = 0.0f, float top = 0.0f, int z_index = 0)
```

The declarative overload: builds `spec` (or takes the node a [ui::Spec](../tree/spec-vocabulary.md#class-spec) holds) and adds it as [add()](#add) does a control. Returns the built node as an [Element](../tree/element.md), or nullptr for an empty [ui::Spec](../tree/spec-vocabulary.md#class-spec), which adds nothing; a spec's `.control` field gives a typed observer.

### set_left

```cpp
void set_left(const Element* child, float left)
```

Sets the left offset of `child`, DIPs, and updates the layout. Ignored for an element that is not a child of this canvas.

### set_top

```cpp
void set_top(const Element* child, float top)
```

Sets the top offset of `child`, DIPs, and updates the layout. Ignored for a non-child.

### set_z_index

```cpp
void set_z_index(const Element* child, int z_index)
```

Sets the z-index of `child`. A higher z-index draws later, on top, and gets input first. Redraws. Ignored for a non-child.

### left

```cpp
float left(const Element* child) const
```

The left offset of `child`, DIPs; 0 for an element that is not a child of this canvas.

### top

```cpp
float top(const Element* child) const
```

The top offset of `child`, DIPs; 0 for a non-child.

### z_index

```cpp
int z_index(const Element* child) const
```

The z-index of `child`; 0 for a non-child.

### parallel_measure_safe

```cpp
bool parallel_measure_safe() const override
```

True: measuring touches only the canvas and its children.

### render_order

```cpp
std::vector<Element*> render_order() const override
```

The children sorted by z-index (stable, so ties keep insertion order), bottom first.

### measure_override

```cpp
Size measure_override(Size available, const MeasureContext& context) const override
```

Measures every child with unbounded room and asks for zero itself.

### arrange_override

```cpp
void arrange_override(const Rect& final_rect, const ArrangeContext& context) override
```

Places each child at its offset from `final_rect`'s top-left, at its desired size.

## class CanvasItemList

A [Canvas](#uicanvas)' children, built, in the same shape as [CellList](grid.md#uicelllist). Callers write it as a braced list of [`ui::CanvasItem{...}`](#uicanvasitem).

### items_

```cpp
std::vector<Placed> items_
```

The placed children, in declaration order.

### CanvasItemList

```cpp
CanvasItemList() = default
```

An empty list.

### CanvasItemList

```cpp
template <typename... S>
CanvasItemList(S&& ... items)
    requires (sizeof...(S) > 0 && (std::same_as<S, CanvasItem> && ...))
```

Builds every item's content and takes ownership of it.

### CanvasItemList

```cpp
CanvasItemList(const CanvasItemList&) = delete
```

### operator=

```cpp
CanvasItemList& operator=(const CanvasItemList&) = delete
```

### CanvasItemList

```cpp
CanvasItemList(CanvasItemList&&) = default
```

### operator=

```cpp
CanvasItemList& operator=(CanvasItemList&&) = default
```

### add

```cpp
void add(CanvasItem item)
```

Builds `item`'s content and appends it, as one more entry of the braced list would.

### struct Placed

One built child with its position; the node is already owned by the list.

| Field | Type | Default | |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `left` | `Binding<float>` |  | Left offset, possibly bound. |
| `top` | `Binding<float>` |  | Top offset, possibly bound. |
| `z_index` | `Binding<int>` |  | Z-index, possibly bound. |
| `node` | `std::unique_ptr<Element>` |  | The built child. |
